frame: world mm, Z up, floor z=0, FRONT=-Y, robot RIGHT=-X. Torso slices in the torso frame (J1 = 0); pan stage / lift parts swept over pan -85..+85 and lift 0..20. Base slices in the base frame; torso parts below the torso floor (z<43) swept over J1 -155..+155. All extents already include +1.0 mm clearance. The shell INNER surface must enclose every slice hull; wall >= 2.0 on top of that.

torso_slices_without_shell_mounted_parts.note: same, without parts that are screwed to the shell anyway (side columns + arm spline sockets, journal ring, speaker, collar ring) - these need no clearance to the shell

torso_top.collar_recess: through-hole r 28.35 in the top wall; the static collar ring (r 26.75..28.25, z 127..133) is glued into a seat ring r 28.4..30.0, z 128..131.5 under the top wall
torso_top.flat_zone: collar plateau flat at z 133 to r 29.8 (as verified in B); beyond it the surface must stay below the head_keepout_profile - 1 mm in EVERY direction (pan +-85 swings the head over the wide X sides too): in practice >= 1.0 mm below z 133 at r 30..46 (K2 placeholder: 1 mm step at r 29.8, body top z 132 with R16 edge)
torso_top.under_top_reserved: nothing static inside r 29.2 between z 87.5 and 127 (pan stage sweep: well corners r 28.1, journal r 28.2); journal ring T_horny_kruh r 28.6..31.5, z 118.5..125.5 must be attached to the shell/frame

head_keepout_profile.note: lowest point of the REAL head over the whole B tilt-vs-lift table and any pan (axisymmetric): the torso top at radius r must stay <= z_min_head - 1.0 (the B-verified exception: the collar plateau r <= 29.8 at z 133 keeps >= 0.25)

torso_bottom.floor: closed except Ø14 hole at (-18, 0) for the J1 servo spline
torso_bottom.plinth: rotating dark skirt r 34.0, z 41.0..42.4 sits in the 3 mm gap between base top (z 40) and torso bottom (z 43); the torso bottom flat zone should be >= r 22 (the skirt shows beyond it as the dark plinth ring of R01)

J1.bearing: 6805-2RS 25x37x7 at z 30.8..37.8 (inner ring on the static hub, outer in the rotating foot ring r 18.5..20.5)
J1.gears: fixed sun gear m1 18T (tip r 10) + orbiting pinion m1 18T at (-18, 0), z 38.8..42.0 (face 3.2); pinion orbit annulus r 8..28 must stay free in the base top layer
J1.base_top_opening: r 29.0 in the base top skin (z 37.8..40)
J1.cable_channel: annulus r 21.5..34.0, z 30.2..37.4 inside the base under the top skin; 6-conductor FPC loop ≈110 mm in the channel, laid out for ±170 (graft K3) so the ±155 hard stop never tensions it
J1.hub_bridge: PACK: PETG beam 60 (X) x 13 (Y) x 6 (Z) at z 23..29 between the battery groups, ends on the motor clamps; carries the J1 hub post (steel M8 core)

fixed_interfaces.pan_cable: PACK: one custom 2-layer polyimide FPC, 8 traces, 3.0 mm wide x 0.12 mm, standing on edge: lift loop in the YZ plane on the well +X end wall (envelope 3.1 x 8 x 23.5, bend R ≈ 3.5) and pan rolling loop on the smooth drum sector of the pan gear (U-turn R 5.2, bend ratio ≈ 43x); replaces the K2 bonded wire ribbon

shoulders.torso_pocket: r 13.5 around the axis, from |x| 37.5 outward (static spline socket r 7 at |x| 37.5..43, cable spiral r 7.5..12.5 at |x| 41.2..43.2)
